fusions.name: Outrider Dart
fusions.desc: A thrown stinger that deals 4 damage, rising to 2.5 times that at maximum range. Its damage rises 5% per 100 paces you run since you last used it (max +25%).

fusions.name: Column Volley
fusions.desc: Looses 5 stingers in a wide fan, each dealing 12 damage. Whenever one hits, your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Marching Song
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4.

fusions.name: Rearguard
fusions.desc: As you move, you gain a ward that soaks 12% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Fighting beside others pays: +11% per ally within 5.5 tiles, capped at 4. Once every 18 seconds.
